evals.prompt: Review this button component: it uses ease-in for hover, no pressed state, and a generic box-shadow on focus. Here is the code: <button className="btn">Buy now</button> with .btn { transition: all 0.3s ease-in; }

Does not use a Before:/After: list format

evals.prompt: Our settings page feels cheap but everything works. Where do we start polishing?

Recommends concrete small details first instead of big changes
Distinguishes trained taste from personal preference
